items.html: And since it reaches the complete navel, as mentioned in Idra de Nasso, page 141a, therefore the measure of this strap is until the navel. And this is what is said in the Tikunim, page 9b: "And the spreading of Bina spreads until Hod." For this language indicates what we said: that her Hod is what spread more than the measure of the Netzah.
